These documents supplement the
[pkgdown site](https://larry-leon.github.io/forestsearch/)
with material that uses Quarto-specific features (`code-tools`, callout blocks,
advanced math rendering) that would require conversion to render on pkgdown.

Each HTML file is **fully self-contained**: open in any browser, share by
email, or host on any static file server without additional assets.

---

## Documents

### [Causal Treatment Effects in the Cox / AFT Framework](cox_causal_review.html)

A unified reference covering:

- Weibull AFT / Cox dual representation and its causal advantages
- The Fay & Li (2024) estimand taxonomy (individual-level vs. population-level)
- Three primary estimands: Average Hazard Ratio (AHR), Controlled Direct
  Effect (CDE), and Marginal Causal HR
- ForestSearch implementation notes for each estimand

---

### [Continuous Biomarker Evaluation](biomarker_comparison.html)

Comparison of STEPP, MFPI, and Spline Cox (`cox_cs_fit`) on GBSG and
simulated data:

- Method descriptions and assumptions
- Side-by-side performance on the GBSG breast cancer dataset
- Simulation-based coverage and bias evaluation

---

## Rendering

From the repo root:

```bash
# All documents
quarto render quarto/

# Single document
quarto render quarto/cox_causal_review.qmd
quarto render quarto/biomarker_comparison.qmd
```

Or from RStudio console:

```r
source("render_quarto_docs.R")
```

Output HTMLs are written to `quarto/_output/`.
